description: A team project run on AKOS: the brief, the backlog and its sprints, the RAID, who's who, the ceremonies and the weekly review, the team board, reporting, action trackers, the artifact register and the onboarding guide.
folders: The backlog: every piece of work, the sprint calendar, and each sprint's team board
Risks, actions, issues and decisions, each with an owner and a date to look again
The sprint records the ceremonies write
The stakeholder register and the communications plan; contacts stay out of git
The status reports and sprint updates, generated from the records
The project's guide for its team and for outsiders, generated from its own files
steps: the stakeholder register, and its contacts file
documents: Why the project exists, its outcome and done-when, what would make it stop, and how it is measured
next: Set up who's who, and who receives what.
